product.description: The product idea in the user's words.
product.x-ask: What product do you want to build first?

target_users.description: Who the user expects to use it first.
target_users.x-ask: Who should use the first version?

market_country.description: Country of the first users. Sets the currency and the competitors to open.
market_country.x-ask: Which country are the first users in?

target_region.description: City, province or state, metro, or whole country where the first users and competitor research should focus. Must fit inside market_country.
target_region.x-ask: Which city, province, or region are the first users in? Say the whole country if it is national.

document_language.description: Language for the prose. Headings stay as written in template.md.
document_language.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

research_mode.description: web when the cited pages were opened during this run. offline when they were not.
research_mode.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

evidence.description: Interviews, signups, payments, or discovery results the user already has. One row that says none yet when there is none.
evidence.x-ask: What customer evidence do you have? Name interviews, signups, payments, or a customer discovery result. Say none yet.

constraints.description: Team, time, budget, skills, and technology limits. One row that says none given when the user names none.
constraints.x-ask: Who will build it, how many weeks can you spend, and what budget, skills, or technology limits apply? Say none given.

first_users.description: The narrow first group, small enough to recruit by hand, who feel the problem most.
first_users.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

core_problem.description: The single most urgent problem the first version solves, from the evidence.
core_problem.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

value_hypothesis.description: If these users get this, they will do this, measured by this.
value_hypothesis.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

competitor_gaps.description: Products the first users could use instead, each opened, and the gap the first version fills.
competitor_gaps.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

user_journey.description: Mermaid flowchart of the one journey the first version supports, from the trigger to the value.
user_journey.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

features.description: Every feature considered, sorted into now, later, or never, with the reason.
features.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

user_stories.description: One story per now feature, with Given-When-Then acceptance criteria.
user_stories.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

manual_steps.description: Steps the team does by hand for the first users instead of building them.
manual_steps.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

risks.description: Value, usability, feasibility, and viability risks, each with how the plan reduces it.
risks.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

build_plan.description: Time-boxed periods from spec to launch, each with the work and the check that says it is done.
build_plan.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

primary_metric.description: The one number that says the first version works. Revenue when anyone pays.
primary_metric.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

launch_metrics.description: Metrics to watch after launch, each with a target and why it matters.
launch_metrics.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

decision_rule.description: The result after launch that means continue, change course, or stop.
decision_rule.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

assumptions.description: Every belief the plan rests on that the evidence did not confirm.
assumptions.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

sources.description: Pages opened for this plan. Empty only when research_mode is offline.
sources.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.
